body:
## What's Changed
* Bump go-runewidth to v0.0.30 for faster startup by @williammartin in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14577
* docs: recommend nix-shell and declarative config for Nix/NixOS by @reginaldalfret in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14592
* Clarify issue view comment output modes by @babakks with @Copilot in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14616
* Add ACCESSIBILITY.md by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14583
* Replace extension browse with Bubble Tea by @williammartin in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14578
* Bump shell-quote to 1.11.0 in cli-exercise skill by @williammartin in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14625
* Leave validation checks to CI in bump-go script by @williammartin in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14631
* Avoid spawning git for each extension at startup by @williammartin in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14620
* Bump Go to 1.27.2 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14632
* chore(deps): bump golang.org/x/sync from 0.23.0 to 0.24.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14633
* chore(deps): bump github.com/mattn/go-colorable from 0.1.15 to 0.1.16 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14634
* Remove CLAUDE.md in favor of AGENTS.md by @jarrensj in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14474
* Fix the unclean background colors of gh-search-code by @A4-Tacks in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14648
* Clarify `--repo` and `--owner` checks for attestation bundles by @bdehamer in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14650
* Fix Go vendoring in Dependabot triage and bump gh-aw by @williammartin in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14682
* chore(deps): bump golang.org/x/crypto from 0.57.0 to 0.58.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14660
* chore(deps): bump actions/upload-artifact from 7.0.1 to 7.0.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14656
* chore(deps): bump actions/download-artifact from 8.0.1 to 8.0.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14655
* chore(deps): bump the codeql-actions group with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14654
* chore(deps): bump charm.land/bubbletea/v2 from 2.0.10 to 2.1.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14657
* chore(deps): bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.83.2 to 1.84.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14485
* chore(deps): bump github.com/cli/go-gh/v2 from 2.16.1 to 2.16.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14696
* chore(deps): bump actions/setup-node from 7.0.0 to 7.1.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14697
* chore(deps): bump goreleaser/goreleaser-action from 7.2.3 to 7.3.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14707
* chore(deps): bump github.com/klauspost/compress from 1.20.1 to 1.20.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14705
* chore(deps): bump actions/create-github-app-token from 3.2.0 to 3.3.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14706
* `gh issue artifact` stack 1/12: Resolve `--attach` references against the body file's directory by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14564
* `gh issue artifact` stack 2/12: Attach one set of files to several Markdown documents by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14565
* `gh issue artifact` stack 3/12: Add the command group and `list` by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14566
* `gh issue artifact` stack 4/12: Add `view` by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14567
* `gh issue artifact` stack 5/12: Add `delete` by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14568
* `gh issue artifact` stack 6/12: Add `download` by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14569
* `gh issue artifact` stack 7/12: Add `create` by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14570
* `gh issue artifact` stack 8/12: Add `edit` by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14571
* `gh issue artifact` stack 9/12: Document `gh issue artifact` in the `gh` skill by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14572
* `gh issue artifact` stack 10/12: Add `edit --restore-version` by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14580
* `gh issue artifact` stack 11/12: Address review feedback by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14640
* `gh issue artifact` stack 12/12: Add artifact URLs by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14678
* Clarify --comments behavior when piped in view commands by @arsalanyavari in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14714
* Support HTML documents in `gh issue artifact` by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14720
* Clarify release creation atomicity and immutability by @bdehamer in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14722
* Add deterministic Dependabot scheduler by @williammartin in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14750
* chore(deps): bump the codeql-actions group with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14751
* Fix help text that references nonexistent flags by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14719
* Bump Go to 1.27.3 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14767
* Merge v2.102.1 release branch into trunk by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14770
* chore(deps): bump github.com/gabriel-vasile/mimetype from 1.4.15 to 1.4.16 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14766
* Update glamour to v2 by @heaths in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14148
* Refreshable tokens (1/7): foundation credential model, storage migration, and file lock by @babakks in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14450
* Refreshable tokens (2/7): refresher domain, OAuth refresher, storage, and wiring by @babakks in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14451
* Refreshable tokens (3/7): short-lived login, refresh, and git credential path by @babakks in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14452
* Refreshable tokens (4/7): gh auth token refresh and secure-storage handling by @babakks in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14453
* Refreshable tokens (5/7): gh auth status short-lived token details by @babakks in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14454
* Refreshable tokens (6/7): agent-task and CAPI per-request refresh by @babakks in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14455
* Refreshable tokens (7/7): guided end-to-end verification scripts by @babakks in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14456
* Refreshable tokens: review fixes across the stack by @babakks in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14663
* Refreshable tokens: rename `--short-lived` flag to `--expiring` by @babakks in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14665
* Refreshable tokens: add `prefer_expiring_credentials` config option by @babakks in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14672
* Refreshable tokens: capture `auth_invocation` telemetry on `login` and `refresh` by @babakks in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14673
* Refreshable tokens: review fixes (round 2) by @babakks in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14717
* Refreshable tokens: show relative time-to-expiry in `gh auth status` by @babakks in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14745
* Refreshable tokens: build-gated debug overrides for testing token expiry by @babakks in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14752
* Refreshable tokens: bump cli/oauth to v1.3.0 and fix `gh status` column width by @babakks in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14768
* Document expiring tokens in the gh skill by @babakks in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14782

## New Contributors
* @reginaldalfret made their first contribution in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14592
* @jarrensj made their first contribution in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14474
* @A4-Tacks made their first contribution in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14648
* @arsalanyavari made their first contribution in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14714

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cli/cli/compare/v2.102.1...v2.103.0
